flare.array_alias_policy: Pinned FLARE uses array only to select the minor-allele-count filter. With the existing explicit min-maf=0 and min-mac=0, true/false are identical effective models. Preserve the original ten outputs; reuse eight unique baselines and record both redundant array aliases.

baseline_policy: The original ten outputs provide eight unique configurations within the98 total. Two redundant array aliases are retained in provenance, not counted twice. Reuse requires independent verification, identical population/protocol checks, exact core-panel matching and equality of aliased predictions.
selection: Grid frozen without inspecting prediction errors; no repeated seeds or external-holdout tuning.
